newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-AMOKACHI REFUSES TO PAY FINE FOR HIRED PLANE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AMOKACHI REFUSES TO PAY FINE FOR HIRED PLANE.

text.p: Nigerian striker Daniel Amokachi is refusing to pay a one billion lira ($8,300) fine imposed on him by his club Besiktas after they had to hire a private plane to get him back to Istanbul in time for a match.

Amokachi returned to Besiktas just half-an-hour before the team were due to play rivals Fenerbahce. Although he played in the match, which Besiktas won 1-0, he had a poor game. He was late getting back to Turkey after missing a connection in London following a visit to his sick mother in Nigeria. It reportedly cost the club 11,000 pounds ($17,820) to hire the plane to get him back.
"I am definitely thinking of not paying this fine," the former Everton striker said.
"I will submit my defence and speak to Rasim Kara the coach about lifting it. I don't believe I committed any crime," Amokachi told the Spor newspaper.
"Punishment will not be a lesson to me, it will just annoy me and harm my contribution to the club."
